patch_description: The prior programs plateau because symmetric pressure-relaxation cannot escape symmetric local optima. Inspired by the recommendation, I add an asymmetric "spreading" pass: each circle is pushed away from the centroid of its nearest contacts (and away from walls when corner-adjacent), which inflates the packing without axis-aligned moves. I combine this with multi-restart seeds (several hex row-count patterns plus jittered variants), an over-inflation pressure loop, and exact LP radii maximization via scipy (fallback to proportional scaling). The best configuration over all restarts is returned.
